gapNote: The trend premise (a penalty call Skattebo and Harbaugh objected to) is not supported: reports describe a league fine after review (no on-field flag) for helmet contact in the Week 3 win over Tennessee, and the only critic quoted is Titans DT Jeffery Simmons. No Harbaugh objection was found. Reports disagree on the fine amount, so the page omits it. The ESPN story could not be opened. Birth date, birthplace and nationality were not stated in any opened source. Gap: the page explains the fine and the record with official stats.
